statusDefinitions.pending: Received as an intake candidate but not eligible for training.
statusDefinitions.blocked: Cannot enter the training corpus until the missing authorization or review is resolved.
statusDefinitions.approved: All required rights, provenance, privacy, safety, quality, deduplication and legal review evidence is present; eligible for explicit promotion.
statusDefinitions.rejected: Must not be ingested into the production training corpus.

note: No external source is being promoted by this file. The repository currently has no externally acquired production-training corpus with project-specific authorization. The internally authored synthetic corpus remains pipeline-validation data only.
